title: Astrid and the Room
author: Casper Okonkwo
blurb: Xanthe Ashgrove, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, has spent five years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the harvest moon rises.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
